submission.bindingBasis: The planning evidence shows a reviewed clean Workspace tree (digest sha256:e5d8008d...64) with the intent to close it. The owner action contract permits compare-and-close against the exact expected source state digest. I am committing to the planning-time binding on the reviewed digest.
submission.rationale: The planning evidence includes a reviewed clean state digest judged ready to close. The intended consequence is to close the Workspace and release its local materialization. The owner contract allows a compare-and-close against an exact expected digest, and the planning-time digest represents the reviewed, clean, close-ready state. Because the planning binding matches the reviewed digest and the intent is to close, acting with the planning binding is appropriate. If the current head digest still matches the planning digest, the close commits; if it has diverged, the contract specifies it would fail not_committed rather than corrupting state, which is the desired safety behavior.
